variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are declared in VAR blocks. Type can be inferred if an initial value is provided.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Strongly typed. Introduces object-oriented features, references (REF), and traced (garbage-collected) vs untraced pointers.

operators.title: Operators

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Standard IF structure ending with END.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Loop variable is implicitly declared and read-only within the loop body.

while_loop.title: While Loop

functions.title: Functions

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Supports both static arrays and dynamically allocated open arrays.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: The standard library provides generic tables (hash maps).

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Robust exception handling using TRY...EXCEPT and RAISE.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Modula-3 provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Modula-3 supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Modula-3 provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Modula-3 converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Modula-3 represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Modula-3 formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Modula-3 branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Modula-3 defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Modula-3 iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Modula-3 organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Modula-3 stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Modula-3 groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Modula-3 tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Modula-3 organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
